🐾 Dr. Christman's Corner

Sponsored by Dr. Adam Christman, DVM, MBA
AC
✦ Guest Curator

Dr. Adam Christman, DVM, MBA, is the Chief Veterinary Officer of dvm360® and one of veterinary medicine's most recognizable voices — a podcast host, social media influencer with over 2 million followers, 2025 AVMA Excellence in Veterinary Media Award recipient, and proud dad to four dachshunds. Known for bringing warmth, humor, and authenticity to the profession, Dr. C co-authored Honey, Have You Squeezed the Dachshund? and has appeared on Good Morning America, the TODAY Show, and beyond. This month, he's curated five games that reflect the things he cares about most: the joy of dogs, the curiosity of clinical science, the weight of emotional labor, and the conversations veterinary professionals deserve to have — but rarely get to practice.

📋

Frankly, Dachshunds

The Long and the Short of Everyone's Favorite Breed — a fun, fact-packed dachshund trivia crossword where surprising doxie truths turn into real-world veterinary takeaways.

Available

Dr. C's Potpourri

Test your instincts against bizarre biology, unexpected diagnoses, and head-tilting pet behaviors. If it made Dr. C say "wait, really?" — it's in here.
